paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The difference between probing a single layer and probing the weighted sum of layers. concat is the concatenation of all layers. 0 is the embedding layer. Large negative values on the y-axis mean that probing the particular layer on the x-axis is much worse than probing the weighted sum of all layers.
model_annotation: The image presents two bar charts illustrating the difference in performance between probing individual layers and probing the weighted sum of layers for two models, mBERT and XLM-R. The horizontal axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 12, with an additional "concat" category. The vertical axis represents the percentage point difference, with labeled ticks at intervals of 2, spanning from -10 to 0. The top chart displays light blue bars for the mBERT model, while the bottom chart displays blue bars for the XLM-R model. For mBERT, the bars decrease in length from approximately -10 for layer 0 to around -1 for layer 6 and beyond, with values ranging from approximately -0.5 to -9.5. For XLM-R, the bars decrease in length from approximately -8.5 for layer 0 to around -0.5 for layer 8 and beyond, with values ranging from approximately -0.5 to -8.5. The "concat" bars for both models are close to 0. The bars are sorted in ascending order by layer number. No bars are visually emphasized.
